product_name_specific: R 1250 GS, R 1250 GS Adventure, R 1250 RT
risk_description: Abrupt braking at higher speeds can overload the gearbox and cause the input shaft to break and to the locking of the gears or the rear wheel, increasing the risk of injuries.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of two- or three-wheel vehicles and quadricycles.
